_about: 1.2 section 5: the commentary team, made from docs/update-1.2/COMMENTARY-TEAM-LINES.md by scripts/commentary-team-data.mjs (edit the sheet, not this). A line plays once its clip is in this folder under its file name.

lines.text: Bonjour from the sand! The players are on their way out, and this crowd is ready.
I'm right beside the court, and I can tell you, the sand is hot and so is the mood.
Both pairs look relaxed down here. That will not last long!
That's the set! You could feel that one coming from down here.
Set over, and the winners barely look out of breath. Incroyable.
One set done. I can hear the losing pair talking it over, and they are not happy.
Time for a drink. Believe me, they need it out here.
A quick drink, a quick word, and then we go again.
One set each! Down here nobody is sitting any more.
And the band is keeping this beach moving. I love it!
The wind is picking up down here. That ball is going to dance.
Under the lights tonight, and it looks magnifique from the sand.
It's over! The winners are hugging right in front of me!
What a finish! I'm going to try to grab a word with the winners.
That's the match! Back to you in the booth. Merci!

introducedBy.text: And joining us today, film star Roxy Calderwood!

lines.text: Thank you for having me! I've done my own stunts, but I have never done this.
I'm Roxy Calderwood, and I'm told there is no stunt double for commentary.
Ooh! Nobody moved! I've seen fight scenes with less of a knockout.
An ace! That is what I call a clean take.
Denied! That's a door slammed right in her face.
What a block! I felt that one from up here.
Oh, that's a blooper. That one goes on the reel.
Long! We've all missed our mark, darling.
This rally has gone on longer than my last film!
I'm exhausted just watching. Somebody yell cut!
Set point? Now this is a cliffhanger.
Match point. I can't look. I'm looking.
They're back in it! Now that is a plot twist.
You know, in "The Dog or Him?" I picked the dog. Today I'm picking the pair in front.
"Sabotage 3: We Didn't See It Coming". Much like that last serve.
And that's a wrap! What a performance!
Roll the credits! I want a sequel!

introducedBy.text: And with us today, a champion in his own right, Kai Brennock!

lines.text: Good to be here! Different sport, same butterflies. I know that feeling well.
Kai Brennock here. I've retired from winning, so today I just watch.
Ace! When you're in that zone, you don't even hear the crowd.
Clean as you like. That's a champion's serve.
Big block! That's pure timing, and you can't teach it.
She read that early. That's hours of training right there.
Shake it off. Every champion has missed one like that.
Out. The next point is the only one that matters now.
Look at the legs on these players! That's real fitness.
Whoever wants it more wins this rally. Simple as that.
Set point. This is where you find out who's got the nerve.
Match point. Breathe. One more good one.
Never count a fighter out. I love to see this.
In my day I'd have been icing my knees by now. These two look fresh.
I'll be honest, sand is harder than it looks. I've tried it. Once.
That's how you close it out! Respect to both pairs.
Winners! Enjoy it. That feeling never gets old.

handovers.speaker: Kailey
handovers.text: Let's go down to Nicole on the sand.

handovers.speaker: Kailey
handovers.text: Nicole Dupont is courtside for us. Nicole?

handovers.speaker: Hukum
handovers.text: What's it like down there, Nicole?

handovers.speaker: Hukum
handovers.text: Ha! Couldn't have put it better myself.

handovers.speaker: Hukum
handovers.text: And that's why we invited you.
